first_pass: one first observed search per query and arm; shared DB and OS caches, not independent cold machines
order: arm index (position + query_index + repetition) modulo 3; repetition zero is first pass
candidate_depth: native SearchFiltered count+1=49; exact cosine over all 48 eligible rows; positive cosine only; lists trimmed to 100; equal-weight RRF k=60
ties: score descending, ID ascending, version ascending
clipping: Harness whole facts, stop at first Unicode-scalar overflow after top5; caller verifies UTF-8 content bytes <=4096. Fixture guarantees any five facts fit both bounds.
embedding: one session, one mixed 84-text forward; CPU intra2 inter1 sequential; passage/query prefixes; right truncate512; preload actual max tokens<=128; dynamic longest padding actual pad ID; float32 attention-mask mean and L2
quality: author-labelled development gold; positive Hit@5, gold count/150 fixed-slot Precision@5, returned non-gold count/share, negatives with any result; no abstention tuning
timing: perf wall clock search-only; saved query vectors; median and nearest-rank p95; first and warm separate; stable IDs/scores checked; repetitions are not quality samples
